description: Get full details for a single Yelp business by its id or alias. Returns rating, review count, price, categories, address, phone, hours, photos, and coordinates. Example: get_business({ id: "garaje-san-francisco" }).

_apiKey.description: Required — your own Yelp Fusion key. Pipeworx fronts no platform key for Yelp (Fusion plan is $229/mo, #2275 open); every call is refused with none.

id.description: Yelp business id or alias (from search_businesses results).

name: get_business
title: Get Business
